seeded_failure.symptom: The window calculation takes an extremely long time and crashes with OutOfMemoryError on task executor 0.
seeded_failure.cause: The window specification was created with Window.orderBy('trip_time') without a partitionBy clause, forcing all rows into one partition.
seeded_failure.fix: Add a valid partitionBy column (e.g. Window.partitionBy('borough').orderBy('trip_time')) to distribute processing across executors.

Deduplication
